display_name: HPD-Parsing - hierarchical parallel decoding, customized vLLM 0.17.1+hpdparsing
runtime_version: vllm 0.17.1+hpdparsing (official customized build; adds dynamic request forking and P-MTP speculative decoding)

inference_config.entrypoint: OpenAI-compatible POST /v1/chat/completions against the official server
inference_config.image_encoding: data:image/png;base64 in an image_url content part

notes: Masterplan section 15.1 names HPD-Parsing as the model that must use its official Docker image rather than a hand-built environment, because the engine is a customized vLLM 0.17.1 fork with dynamic request forking and P-MTP. The offline image is used so no weight download happens at pod boot. Output is NOT markdown: the model emits `<BLOCK><type> [x1,y1,x2,y2]<CHILD><text>` segments, which canonical.py converts using the block regex published in the official tutorial. The prompt is fixed at `document parsing with fork.` and load() refuses any other prompt text. base_image is digest-pinned to the manifest an anonymous Harbor token read returned on 2026-09-03 (the same digest lane F recorded in build/build_plan.json); the image config carries ENTRYPOINT ["/bin/bash", "/home/hpd/entrypoint.sh"], so bootstrap mode overrides it through RunPod REST v1 dockerEntrypoint per ARENA_CONTRACT D2 and runtime_mode_allowed keeps both modes. Resolution provenance and every open question live in provenance.json next to this file. D19/D34 (2026-09-03 second integration pass): the official image's own ENTRYPOINT (/bin/bash /home/hpd/entrypoint.sh) starts the customized vLLM server, and the arena entrypoint.sh now does the same thing rather than leaving it to the adapter: it renders the `vllm serve` argv and env from adapter.py --print-server-plan (one builder, so the two cannot drift), polls server.ready_probe for up to ready_timeout_seconds (1800 s, above the D19 20-minute floor), fails hard on timeout, then runs the worker as a child, waits on it, propagates its exit code and stops the server from a trap. The adapter attaches when ARENA_MODEL_SERVER_MANAGED_BY=entrypoint. prompt_kind is "text": adapter.OFFICIAL_PROMPT ('document parsing with fork.') is what is sent, load() refuses any other prompt_text and refuses an empty one, and prompt_registry/hpd_parsing_document_parsing_with_fork_v1.txt must hold exactly that text. There is no runtime_repository/runtime_revision because the engine is a customized vLLM fork that upstream publishes only as the Docker image; the image digest is the runtime pin and inventing a source repository would be fabricated data. model_repo @ model_revision was re-verified read-only against the Hugging Face revision API on 2026-09-03. Framework-floor audit (2026-09-03, after the GLM-OCR canary died on an unrecognised model_type): the required framework floor, what the pinned base image actually ships, the action taken and the evidence URLs are recorded in provenance.json under framework_floor_audit. bootstrap.sh asserts the pinned framework versions and that the framework recognises this checkpoint's architecture before anything starts.
